## Germination Rate

Focus on acorn germination rate for each tag once and only the most recent record

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
#install.packages("plyr")
library(plyr)
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
